items.q: What does he say the 30s collect?
items.a: Feelings the **20s deferred**. The bill shows up in the **body**, in relationships, and in work he was already smart enough to fix. Gossip is often unprocessed **anger**. Years without crying are unprocessed **grief**.

items.q: How does he feel on purpose?
items.a: About **20 minutes** of breathwork, and a private room with one song where he **moves strangely**. He found dance better for feeling good than lifting and better for loosening than stretching.

**I love you, no.** He used to shut love off before he could separate. The firing call opened with **I love you. This is so hard.** The gut line is **it just doesn't feel right for me**, which is fit, not a verdict.

items.q: How does status change what people show you?
items.a: A waiter overhears people who are **not performing**. A million subscribers and a **salary** make closeness pay. Mission is a **track record**. If they loved charisma they would already have written about it.

items.q: What order does he name for the phases?
items.a: **Complacency, optimization, feeling, then spirituality.** He keeps the introverted kid and the optimizer. At 17 he thought Harris and Hitchens had settled atheism. He now tells his 30-year-old self he is a **soul**.

items.q: What happens if you defer feelings?
items.a: They **accrue 'interest'** and show up later as body issues, stuck relationships, and recurring work problems.
**Breathwork (~20 min)**, private dance/weird movement, and **judging people's mission by track record** not words.
